snippet_primary: "Etsy purchases offsite advertising from a network of participating partners, such as social networks and search engines. If such advertising includes your listing, a buyer clicks on it, and then places any orders from your shop within 30 days of that click, you will be charged an advertising fee on these orders (which we'll refer to collectively as 'Attributed Orders' and individually as an 'Attributed Order'); provided, however, if within that 30 days a buyer's last click before placing the order from your shop is an Etsy Ad then only the Etsy Ads fee will apply."
subject_exact: Etsy policy states Offsite Ads fee applies to orders placed within 30 days of an offsite ad click; if buyer's last click before ordering is an Etsy Ad, only Etsy Ads fee applies (Last Click Attribution)
time_scope_raw: 30 days (attribution window after offsite ad click)
local_qualifiers: Offsite Ads: Etsy purchases from partner networks (social networks, search engines)
advertising fee applies to orders placed within 30 days of buyer click on offsite ad (Attributed Orders)
Last Click Attribution: if buyer's last click before ordering is an Etsy Ad, only Etsy Ads fee applies
